description: This file defines a mock class MessageDispatcherMock for unit testing, which inherits from IMessageDispatcher and uses Google Mock to mock the createClient method. It is part of a testing suite for message dispatching components.

classes.name: MessageDispatcherMock
classes.description: A mock implementation of IMessageDispatcher for testing purposes, providing a mocked createClient method.

methods.name: createClient
methods.description: A mocked method that creates a client, returning a unique pointer to IMessageDispatcherClient, taking a pointer to firebolt::rialto::IMediaKeysClient as parameter.
